# Upstream fixture provenance

- Source: <https://github.com/InDataWG/ILCD-EPD-Data-Format>
- Branch/release: `release/v1.3`
- Commit: `7625c7dfc0d5b6bc2020eb0cf0b0503349c914aa`
- Imported path: XML files below upstream `sample_data/`
- Imported on: 2026-08-26
- Upstream repository license: Apache-2.0; the complete license text is in
  `UPSTREAM-LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt`.

Only XML sample data is mirrored here. Upstream PDFs, images, schemas,
stylesheets, generated documentation, and external documents are intentionally
excluded. The fixture corpus is also excluded from the published crate package;
it exists as repository test evidence.

The presence of a fixture proves parser behavior against that document only. It
does not establish provider API compatibility, XML Schema conformance, or ISO
22057 conformance.
